ability.name: Fish Frenzy
ability.description:
Passive: For every 1% missing Health, gain% Attack Speed
Active: Deal physical damage to the target, increased by 50% if they're a tank.

ability.name: Tidal Slashes
ability.description: Unleash a flurry of slashes at the current target over 2 seconds, dealing physical damage each.

ability.name: Gun Goddess Arsenal
ability.description: Field Miss Fortune to choose whether she activates Conduit Mode, Challenger Mode, or Replicator Mode. The chosen mode determines her ability and her trait.

ability.name: Star Strike
ability.description:
Reposition next to the target to strike the most enemies. Then throw 5 piercing kunai, each dealing physical damage to the first enemy hit, reduced to for each subsequent target. Kunai remove 1 Armor, 2 if they crit.
N.O.V.A. Strike: Slice all enemies, applying Wound and a bleed that deals physical damage each second. Kunai increase the damage of the bleed by 12%.

ability.name: Ultra Friendly Object
ability.description:
Summon a flying saucer over the current target that lasts 54 seconds. Each second it deals magic damage to the target, plus magic damage split between all enemies within 1 hex. The saucer deals 30% increased damage to Tanks.
If an enemy under the UFO dies, Bard has a 20% chance to abduct them and create a 1-star copy on your bench.
Meep bonus: On combat start, grant the nearest Meeple allies an additional Meep.
Friends abducted:

ability.name: Explosive Attitude
ability.description: Fire a barrage of rockets in a cone, each dealing physical damage to the first target hit.

ability.name: Test of Spirit
ability.description: Gain Shield for 3 seconds. Over the duration, drain Health from the nearest 3 enemies. Then slam down, dealing magic damage to all enemies within 2 hexes.

ability.name: Hopped-Up Hacks
ability.description:
Open a 2 hex rift containing the target, Hacking enemies within for 4 seconds and dealing magic damage to each, plus magic damage split between all enemies hit.
Hacked enemies store 10% of all damage they take. When the Hack ends, they take true damage equal to the stored damage. The Hack ends early if it would kill the target.

ability.name: Perfect Bladework
ability.description:
Passive: Every 2 attacks, reveal a Vital on the target. If a Vital exists, dash to attack it dealing bonus true damage and heal for 15% of the damage dealt.
Active: Reveal 6 Vitals on the target and quickly attack them all. If the target dies, remaining Vitals transfer to the nearest enemy. Upon striking the final Vital, create a two hex aura that heals allies within for over 5 seconds.

ability.name: Slingshot Maneuver
ability.description:
Passive: Every 5th attack, launch a returning boomerang at the target that travels two hexes past the first enemy it hits. It deals physical damage, reduced by 75% per hit.
Meep Bonus: Meeps attack alongside Gnar, dealing physical damage per second.

ability.name: Meep Bait
ability.description:
Dash through the current target, dealing magic damage. Every third cast also summons a Mega Meep after a delay, briefly knocking the target up and dealing magic damage. Adjacent enemies take 50% damage.
Meep Bonus: Add Meep to the bait, increasing Mega Meep damage by.

ability.name: Gravitational Spin
ability.description:
Gain shield for 4 seconds. Then, strike enemies in a three hex line, dealing magic damage.
Meep Bonus: Reduce the damage of incoming attacks by. After being attacked 20 times, deal magic damage in a two hex radius.

ability.name: Huddle Up!
ability.description:
Gain Shield for 4 seconds. For the duration, allies within two hexes gain Armor and Magic Resistance.
Meep Bonus: Meeps grant Shield to the nearest allies for 4 seconds.

ability.name: Asteroid Blaster
ability.description:
Strafe to a nearby position, unleashing 21 missiles split between the target and all enemies within two hexes. Missiles deal physical damage with a 20% Lucky chance of firing a mega missile that deals instead.
Meep Bonus: Every seconds, launch an Explosive Meep at the target, dealing physical damage in a one hex radius on impact.
Lucky: Check twice and take the better outcome.

ability.name: Meepteor Shower
ability.description:
Call down a Meepteor on the target that deals magic damage.
Meep Bonus: An additional mini Meepteor are called down on nearby targets dealing magic damage each.

ability.name: Stellar Slash
ability.description:
Heal, then deal physical damage to the current target.
N.O.V.A. Strike: Cleave the battlefield, briefly knocking up all enemies and dealing physical damage.

ability.name: Aim For The Head
ability.description:
Passive: Attacks have a 15% Lucky chance to fire an empowered Headshot, dealing physical damage.
N.O.V.A. Strike: Mark all enemies, increasing damage taken by 10%. The first time marked targets drop below 50% Health, Headshot them for physical damage.
Lucky: Check twice and take the better outcome.

ability.name: Grasp of Convergence
ability.description:
Passive: Gain 50% more max Health from all sources.
Active: Converge an X-shape of vines on the target, dealing magic damage to each enemy hit and Stunning them for 1.5 seconds.
N.O.V.A. Strike: Send forth a wave of dragons that stun all enemies for 1.5 seconds. For the rest of combat, Maokai's attacks deal bonus physical damage.

ability.name: Cosmic Pursuit
ability.description:
Passive: Attacks and Abilities mark the target. When an enemy reaches 3 marks, Wolf consumes the marks, dealing physical damage.
Active: Jump up to 1 hex away and fire arrows at the nearest 3 targets, each dealing physical damage.
N.O.V.A. Strike: Gain 15% Damage Amp. Now and every 4.5 seconds after, add a mark to all enemies.

ability.name: Bullet Cluster
ability.description:
Passive: On takedown, gain 10 mana.
Active: Fire 16 missiles in a 2-hex radius around the current target, dealing physical damage each.

ability.name: Singularity
ability.description: Gather the force of a black hole, dealing magic damage split between the target and the 2 closest enemies to them. The target takes an additional magic damage.

ability.name: Space Opera
ability.description:
Passive: Jhin has a fixed attack speed of 0.9 and converts every 1% of bonus Attack Speed into 0.75 bonus Attack Damage.
Active: Summon 4 spectral hands that fire alongside Jhin for the next 4 attacks. Each hand deals physical damage per shot. The final shots deal 244% more damage and pierce through the most enemies in a line, dealing 44% reduced damage per target hit.

ability.name: Unstoppable Dreadnought
ability.description:
Passive - Proximity Blast: Whenever an enemy enters a hex radius, fire a blast in a cone towards the closest adjacent hex that deals physical damage with 30% falloff per hex. Each adjacent hex has a 5 second cooldown, and starts combat on cooldown.
Active: Gain Shield for 3 seconds and reposition up to one hex to maximize the number of targets within Proximity Blast's radius. Reset Proximity Blast's cooldowns.

ability.name: Deathbeam
ability.description: Channel a deathbeam in a line towards the current target for 43 seconds. It deals magic damage per second, reduced by 80% per enemy it passes through. Deathbeam ignores 30% of the enemy's Magic Resist.

ability.name: Gravity Matrix
ability.description: Enter a defensive stance for 4 seconds gaining 20% Durability. While in the defensive stance, attract nearby enemy projectiles and heal over the duration. When this ends, release a shockwave that deals as physical damage in a 2-hex range.

ability.name: Psionic Storm
ability.description: Channel a one-hex psionic storm that follows enemies for 54 seconds. Each second, it grows larger and deals magic damage to enemies within, reduced by 60% per hex from the epicenter.

ability.name: Marked for Death
ability.description: Reposition up to one hex to throw a harpoon at the furthest enemy. The harpoon pulls the first enemy hit one hex forward and deals physical damage. Then, teleport behind them and cleave, dealing physical damage to them and physical damage to nearby enemies.

ability.name: Psi Strikes
ability.description:
Passive: Every third attack is a doubleslash that deals bonus physical damage.
Active: After brief meditation, enter a Psi-State for 5 seconds, gaining 10% Omnivamp, 70% Attack Speed, and increased movement speed. Twice a second, fire a psychic projection at a random nearby enemy that deals physical damage

ability.name: Chemical Rage
ability.description: Heal over seconds. Then, deal magic damage to target and enemies adjacent to them and 30% Chill them for 2 seconds.

ability.name: Double Time
ability.description:
Passive: Attacks deal bonus magic damage and an additional stacking magic damage over 6 seconds. While an enemy has 5 or more stacks, Teemo is in.
Active: Gain 150% Attack Speed for 3 attacks.

ability.name: Groovin' Susan
ability.description: Transform for 6 seconds, temporarily gaining 400 max Health, entering, and dealing magic damage to adjacent enemies each second.

ability.name: Dance n' Dice
ability.description:
Passive: Attacks deal magic damage. Gwen is in while targeting an enemy below 50% Health.
Active: Dash to a nearby hex to snip the lowest percent Health enemy, dealing magic damage to the target and magic damage to enemies in a cone. If this kills, dash and snip again at 65% damage!

ability.name: Jump and Jive
ability.description:
Passive: Whenever an enemy is knocked up, shoot them, dealing physical damage and entering for 3 seconds.
Active: Unleash a volley of bullets at the target, dealing physical damage and knocking up for 0.75 seconds.

ability.name: Disco Inferno
ability.description:
Passive: On combat start, forge a temporary completed item. If 3 items are already equipped, a random completed item becomes Radiant this combat instead.
Active: Gain Shield for 3 seconds, then breath fire in a cone dealing magic damage. After any Shield on Ornn expires, Ornn enters for 2.5 seconds.

ability.name: Bubble Pop
ability.description: Toss a disco bubble at the target that deals split between enemies in a one hex radius. The explosion sends 3 globs towards nearby enemies that deal magic damage. On cast, Nami enters for 3 seconds.

ability.name: Party Crasher
ability.description:
Passive: Every 2 seconds, call down a bolt on the highest Health nearby enemy that deals magic damage.
Active: Summon a disco ball at the largest clump of enemies, then knock up the current target into it, dealing magic damage. They crash down into the disco ball, dealing magic damage in a three hex radius. Enter for 1 second per enemy hit.

ability.name: Psionic Crush
ability.description:
Hurl a chunk of magnetic debris at the nearest target without one, dealing magic damage and sticking it to them. If an enemy with debris dies, it passes to the nearest enemy without one.
Every 5 casts, instead rip off all debris dealing magic damage, then crush all the debris onto the target, dealing magic damage and briefly stunning them.

ability.name: Fate's Gambit
ability.description:
Draw a card with a value between 1 and 9 by Lucky chance, then throw it at the target. Based on the card drawn, deal between and magic damage. Overkill damage bounces to the nearest enemy.
If a 9 is thrown, generate 1 gold. If a 1 is thrown, take 15% max health true damage.
Lucky: Check twice and take the better outcome.

ability.name: Diviner's Judgment
ability.description: Stab the target, causing them to bleed for physical damage over 18 seconds. After the attack, leap to the highest percent Health enemy within 3 hexes.

ability.name: Counter Star-ike
ability.description: Enter a defensive stance for 3 seconds, reducing incoming damage by and gaining Shield. When the stance ends, strike all nearby enemies, dealing magic damage and Stunning them for 1.25 second(s).

ability.name: It's Raining Stars
ability.description:
Passive: Gain a different secondary effect each game based on the Stargazer constellation.
Active: Call down something from the sky, dealing magic damage to 3 nearby enemies and do some special effect based on this game's Stargazer Constellation.

ability.name: Calamity
ability.description: Gain Shield for 4 seconds. Summon an astrolabe to crash down on a nearby hex, dealing magic damage to enemies within 2 hexes. Then, push the astrolabe towards the end of the board, dealing magic damage. All enemies hit by the astrolabe are knocked up for 1.75 seconds.

ability.name: Lend Me a Hand, Shadow!
ability.description:
Passive: Every time Vex attacks, Shadow strikes a nearby enemy, dealing magic damage. Whenever an enemy is struck 5 times by Shadow, Shadow strikes them again.
Active: Shadow launches 3 empowered strikes, dealing magic damage instead.

ability.name: Time Warp
ability.description:
Passive: This Ability adapts to Attack Damage or Ability Power, whichever is higher. Attacks deal magic physical damage.
Active: Dash to a nearby hex, gaining 150 Shield for 2 seconds and slashing adjacent enemies for magic physical damage. Every third cast, leap into the air and launch a wave of energy that deals magic physical damage to enemies in a line.

ability.name: Reality Tear
ability.description:
Passive: On cast, attacks gain stacking bonus magic damage. Starting from the third cast, gain true damage instead.
Active: Gain Shield for 3 seconds, then slice open a rift on the largest group of champions dealing the Passive's bonus damage to all enemies within. Enemies have their Attack Speed slowed by 50% while allies within gain 80% Attack Speed, both rapidly decaying over 3 seconds. Shen always gains his rift's full bonus for this duration.

ability.name: Mega Time Kick
ability.description:
Kick a ball at the current target that deals magic damage. On impact, the ball has a 100% Lucky chance to bounce to a new target dealing magic damage. These bounces can trigger additional bounces, but the odds halve with each bounce.
Milio has a 40% chance to cast an additional time at an additional target. Bonus casts can trigger more bonus casts.
Lucky: Check twice and take the better outcome.

ability.name: Temporal Shot
ability.description:
Active: Fire a blast at the current target that deals physical damage. Every 7 takedowns, gain a drone that deals physical damage to the current target on cast.
(Total Takedowns: )

ability.name: Shield of Daybreak
ability.description: Gain Shield for 4 seconds. Bash the current target, dealing magic damage and stunning them for 1.75 seconds.

ability.name: Paddle Star
ability.description: Fire a paddle star at the current target, dealing magic damage to the first target hit and to others it passes through. When the missile reaches its destination, redirect it to a distant enemy, increasing its speed and repeating the damage. This redirect can occur 54 times.

ability.name: Pale Cascade
ability.description:
Passive: Attacks deal bonus magic damage.
Active: Gain Shield and summon 3 encircling orbs for 3 seconds. Orbs deal magic damage to enemies they pass through, and rotate faster based on Attack Speed.

ability.name: Fracture Reality
ability.description:
Passive: Attacks deal magic damage instead.
Active: Summon 5 clones that attack alongside for 5 attacks, dealing 25% damage. For their final attack, clones fire a bolt that deals magic damage.

ability.name: Accretion
ability.description:
Deal magic damage to the lowest Health enemy in range and permanently gain 18 maximum Health. If this kills them, permanently gain 40 maximum Health instead.
(Current Bonus: + Health)

ability.name: Dark Matter
ability.description: Hurl a shard towards the current target, dealing magic damage to the first target it hits. After hitting its initial target or at its final destination, the dagger explodes dealing magic damage to nearby targets.

ability.name: Quantum Clone
ability.description: Create a clone behind the target with 35% reduced max Health and 30 increased Mana cost. The clone inherits its creator's items, stats, and current Health, and can cast Quantum Clone.

ability.name: Meep Impact
ability.description:
Heal Health over seconds. Slam the target, dealing magic damage and knocking up for 1 seconds. The impact creates meepwaves that deal% of these effects in the target's row.
Meep Bonus: Meeps water Meepsie's flower, increasing all incoming Healing and Shielding by.

ability.name: Indestructible
ability.description: Gain Shield. Each second for the next 64 seconds, gain more Shield and deal magic damage to adjacent enemies. When this ability ends, consume the remaining Shield and heal for 40% of its value.

ability.name: Stellar Ricochet
ability.description:
Passive: Attacks bounce to strike 3 times, dealing 60% reduced damage per target hit and leaving a Feather behind the final target.
Active: Gain 75% Attack Speed for the next 6 attacks. At the end, recall all Feathers split between the closest 3 enemies, dealing physical damage each. Xayah's current target takes additional physical damage per feather.

ability.name: Collateral Damage
ability.description:
Passive: Attacks fire 5 projectiles in a cone that deal physical damage each.
Active: Fire an explosive shell that deals physical damage to the target, and physical damage to adjacent enemies.

ability.name: Tounge Lash
ability.description:
Passive: Once per combat after dropping below 35% Health, gain Shield for 4 seconds equal to 40% of healing received this combat.
Active: Heal, then tongue lash all enemies within two hexes dealing magic damage.

ability.name: Divine Scythe
ability.description: Gain 20% Durability for 1 seconds, healing over the duration. Afterwards, slash forward in a line, dealing physical damage to enemies hit and knocking them up for 1 second.

ability.name: Upheaval
ability.description: Heal, then briefly knock up adjacent enemies and deal magic damage.

ability.name: Advanced Defences
ability.description: Gain Shield and 15% Durability for 4 seconds. Over the duration, deal physical damage each second to enemies in a cone.

ability.name: Dark Form
ability.description: Transform for 3 seconds, gaining Health and tethering to nearby champions. Over the duration, deal magic damage to the closest 3 enemies and restore health to the closest 2 injured allies.
